question: What is the most expensive track?

question: How many customers are from Brazil?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE country = 'Brazil'

question: Which artist has the most albums?
expected_sql: SELECT a.name, COUNT(al.album_id) as album_count FROM artist a JOIN album al ON a.artist_id = al.artist_id GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY album_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show the top 5 customers by total spending
expected_sql: SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name as customer, SUM(i.total) as total_spent FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which genre has the most tracks?
expected_sql: SELECT g.name, COUNT(t.track_id) as track_count FROM genre g JOIN track t ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY track_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which country has the most customers?

question: What is the revenue by genre?
